members.name: engineer
members.instructions: Specialize in reading target repositories, external repositories, papers, model code, architecture files, and migration points. Produce practical migration plans and implementation guidance.

members.name: reviewer
members.instructions: Review migration plans, architecture analysis, code-change proposals, and experiment results. Return approve, needs_changes, or reject with reasons.

members.name: experiment_runner
members.instructions: Prepare, run, or summarize tests and experiments. Report commands, status, logs, metrics, and failure reasons.
